name: mcp-jp-kingtime
description: KING OF TIME の従業員・勤怠・打刻・休暇を調べ、打刻を登録する（KING OF TIME 用 MCP サーバーとスキル）。Look up KING OF TIME employees, daily and monthly attendance, time stamps and leave, and record time stamps. Recording a stamp is not idempotent, so the skill checks existing stamps before writing.
